summary.en:
- Silver Wolf provides a large amount of AoE RES Pen and DEF Down through her Skill and Ultimate, amplifying damage dealt.
- Silver Wolf's Skill implants the enemy with the Weakness Type of the first ally target in the lineup while also reducing the target enemy's RES to that Weakness Type. Enemies can only have 1 Weakness Type implated by Silver Wolf at a time.

details.en:
- E1 grants her additional Energy when using her Ultimate to attack debuffed enemies.
- E2 allows all allies' attacks to inflict debuffs, which greatly increases her synergy with Acheron. However, her E2 loses much of its value when not being used with Acheron.
